description: Reads the human-decision queue. view list returns approvals newest first, one page at a time, optionally filtered by state; a member sees the queue of their own numbers. view one returns one approval with exactly what the human is shown (preview) and the arguments of the held action. view action_types returns every action type that can require approval with its default risk. Previews and arguments can quote customers and come back marked untrusted. A person sets the workspace’s mode per type, and decides each approval, in the Cosend dashboard. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

state.description: With view list: only approvals in this state.

view.description: list lists approvals. one reads one approval by id. action_types lists what can need approval.

name: get_approvals
title: Read approvals
